### New

- **Mini-apps in the web app.** Webxdc apps now run in the browser/PWA version of Velta, in a sandbox without network access. Velta Beam shows that direct transfer isn't available in the web app yet.
- **App info messages.** Messages an app posts to the chat (for example "Alice voted") show the app's icon; tap one to open the app at the right place.
- **Chat info media.** Tapping a photo, video or app in chat info opens it again, and every item has **Show in chat** to jump to that message.
- **Audio player.** Voice notes and audio files in chats and in chat info get a full-width player with play, seek and "current / total" from the start.

### Fixes

- **Polls and other apps keep their state.** Reopening an app restored nothing and live updates stopped after the first batch; both work now.
- **Readable apps in dark theme.** Apps with a white background no longer show white text on white.
- **Forwarded app cards** no longer stay stuck on a placeholder.
- **Web app boot.** Fixed two problems that left the web app on an empty screen: a library file the server sent with the wrong type, and a crash when tapping Diagnostics while the core was still loading.
